judgments.verdict: Bespoke receipts and laws carry fast power versus touch into five linked material choices with enforced resistance.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world to recover making where fast generation outruns touch and naming restores answerable material. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into probe of effortlessness, visible seam, ledger beam, unfinished boundary and forgetting rehearsal linked by chain and facets. Other levels: Below as mere motif repetition fails against bespoke causal prose; above as sustained rich alternatives fails because future outputs revert to thin generic templates.

judgments.verdict: The five bespoke receipts and working tools carry the portal-into-material tension into connected, resisting choices a successor can continue.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether effortless power can be turned back into touchable material where resistance restores authorship. Reading: The bespoke probe-to-rehearsal arc plus enforced seam, ledger beam and open pressures carries that tension into several linked choices. Other levels: Below would be mere motif repetition without causal chain, above would need sustained alternatives and wider consequences; purely generic template output would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Five bespoke receipts carry portal speed, loss of touch, seam, ledger and unfinishedness into linked pressures, facets and field marks.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world to recover fast power against loss of touch turned into touchable material. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into probe, chisel, beam, boundary and rehearsal with distinct answers, pressures, facet shifts and field positions. Other levels: Below would be motif repetition without causal chain, falsified by bespoke pressures and facet changes; above would need alternatives sustained through consequences, falsified by lost joy and template reduction.

judgments.verdict: One operator holds every creative hand while engine and store only fill templates and validate.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a joint human-AI-material encounter where each can ask, shape, hold, refuse and share change. Reading: The artefact gives all shaping to a single operator; the oracle is deterministic filler and the store only checks syntax and chain. Other levels: Below as collapsed absence fails because validation and pressures do answer; above as reciprocal influence fails because simulated pressure and host-authored text are not independent contributions.

judgments.verdict: All five hands are held by one operator using a template oracle that disclaims personhood, so the encounter stays an instrument.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for distinct human, intelligence and material positions that can each shape a shared change. Reading: Only the operator can place probe, chisel, beam, boundary or rehearsal while the oracle only fills templates, so agency collapses to single-operator use. Other levels: Above would need reciprocal influence or preserved disagreement across changes; evidence of bilateral acceptance of a shared change would falsify.

judgments.verdict: One operator works all hands by form or terminal while the oracle only fills templates from that text.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a meeting where both human and intelligence bring purpose, constraints and refusal. Reading: The artefact leaves all gesture switches to one operator and reduces intelligence to deterministic fill, making an instrument with reactive material. Other levels: Below would be no roles at all, falsified by material refusals and facet shifts; above would need reciprocal shaping, falsified by lack of independent proposal or refusal.

judgments.verdict: Operator boundaries and resource refusals appear, but no participant can withhold agreement or revise it with history intact.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks each participant to accept, question, limit or withdraw from a shared direction. Reading: The work shows operator choice and chain or length refusals, yet the engine cannot express a disposition and no change needs bilateral agreement. Other levels: Below as no boundary fails against the unfinishedness wall and chain checks; above as mutual boundary fails because engine refusals are syntax checks, not positions.

judgments.verdict: Only the operator's choices and the store's chain refusals bound action; no shared direction needs both sides to agree or allows joint revision.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether each side can accept, question, limit or withdraw from a joint direction. Reading: The artefact shows operator choice and resource refusal of short, unknown or chain-breaking writes, but no second position that can limit or withdraw while preserving history. Other levels: Below would be no expressed boundary at all, above would require both positions to express disposition; a required bilateral acceptance would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Operator limits and formal refusals of short, duplicate or chain-breaking writes appear, but no shared change needs agreement.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for cooperation where each can accept, question, limit or withdraw while preserving history. Reading: The artefact lets the operator draw boundaries and lets store and server refuse malformed writes, but valid gestures proceed unilaterally. Other levels: Below would be no boundary at all, falsified by explicit refusals; above would need both positions able to limit direction, falsified because the engine cannot refuse substance and receipts cannot be revised.

judgments.verdict: Gestures meet inspectable refusal and facet or pressure costs that return through take-up into the next probe.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a contribution to meet resistance, expose consequence and return it into next choice. Reading: Validation, facet shifts, pressure opening and ghost futures form a coherent rehearsal-resistance-revision loop with take-up. Other levels: Below as decorative feedback fails against enforced refusals and rerendered field; above as local-wider connection fails because deltas stay inside ledger numbers without bolt-to-city propagation.

judgments.verdict: Gestures meet facet shifts, new pressures and chain refusals that return into the next take-up choice, with rehearsal keeping cost visible as ghost.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a contribution can meet resistance, expose consequence and return it into the next choice. Reading: Each gesture changes facets, may open pressure and can be refused, and pressures can be taken up into the probe while rehearsal holds two futures. Other levels: Below would be decorative feedback, above would need local and wider consequences linked across loops; pressures that never constrain the next gesture would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Each hand returns response, pressure, facet shift and field mark that feed take-up, persistence and the next choice.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a loop where action meets resistance, cost becomes visible and returns into next choice. Reading: The artefact forms a coherent loop of gesture, inspectable answer and pressure, facet and field change, take-up and atomic persistence with ghost kept. Other levels: Below would be decorative feedback, falsified by facet and chain checks; above would need local and wider consequences linked, falsified by confinement to one world file.

judgments.verdict: Local-first workbench, ledger, pressures and server or terminal paths show coherent source-grounded purpose with stated limits.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks grounded choices of medium, scope and next steps that keep intention legible. Reading: The maker chose dependency-free local instrument with inspectable oracle, chained trail and unfinishedness over fluent power, with explicit rationale. Other levels: Below as weak connection fails against protocol and provenance; above as explicit alternatives opening new direction fails because rejected media were not compared, gaps remain future work.

judgments.verdict: The local-first workbench, rule-based oracle and legible trail show reasoned medium and scope, with unfinished alternatives and a concrete next move made explicit.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of material and scope that let laws carry growth without losing the smallest bolt. Reading: The maker selects offline dependency-free workbench with inspectable oracle, chained ledger and fallback, and documents what was deliberately not finished plus a specific rehearsal move. Other levels: Below would be weak seed connection, above is already met by explicit limits; an unreasoned medium or hidden addition would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Local-first offline instrument with five hands and chained ledger is chosen and documented with coherent seed grounding.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium, scope and next steps where questioning stays a gesture. Reading: The artefact commits to dependency-free local workbench with rule-based oracle and ledger, mapping portal to workbench with documented scope. Other levels: Below would be weak seed link, falsified by direct hand-to-gesture mapping; above would need explicit alternatives opening new directions, partly present in unfinished lists but narrowed to one world.

judgments.verdict: Several relations stay traceable in tools and behaviour while bilateral ownership narrows to unilateral operation.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives, transforms or is lost when conjecture becomes artefacts. Reading: Memory, five hands, receipt trail, refusing boundary and rehearsed ghost remain traceable, but either-participant grammar and scale recognition flatten to operator templates. Other levels: Below as vocabulary only fails against structural effects and chain; above as preserved depth with explicit additions fails because joint acceptance is lost.

judgments.verdict: Gesture grammar, trail and unfinishedness survive as structure while the mutual intelligence relation narrows to templates, with additions and gaps documented.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what of portal-becoming-material survives when recompiled into another medium. Reading: Several relations become structure — hands, receipt chain, pressures, seam and unfinished boundary — while intelligence-as-participant narrows to rule templates and companion stops at workbench. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary without structure, above would preserve bilateral depth; silent reinterpretation of receipts would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Question, constraint, invariant, refusal, rehearsal and trail become tools, ledger, pressures and workbench with additions and limits documented.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives, transforms or stays unresolved when conjecture becomes artefacts. Reading: The artefact traces several relations into behaviour and marks introduced chain, facets and fallback plus deliberate gaps. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary only, falsified by behavioural ledger and pressures; above would need full relational depth preserved, falsified by collapsed intelligence and lost joy.

judgments.verdict: Living state, seed, fallback, ledger, pressures and protocol give a usable entry that keeps history legible and questions open.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a successor to recover intention and change direction while keeping earlier work legible. Reading: State, checksum, ledger, six pressures, handoffs and browser, server and terminal entries support a recoverable next move. Other levels: Below as narrow durability fails against multiple entry paths and take-up; above as several directions reopening joint relation fails because resolving gesture and multi-world are absent.

judgments.verdict: Ordered reading, living state, open pressures, take-up, export and generated door let a successor recover intention and place a disagreeing gesture.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether what is inherited stays open to question and revision by a next hand. Reading: State, ledger prefix, six open pressures and protocol with take-up, terminal place and door generation support a recoverable disagreeing move. Other levels: Below would be described step without usable entry, above would reopen the joint relation in several directions; a stale fallback or broken prefix would falsify.

judgments.verdict: Reading order, living state with chain, open pressures, export and generated door let a successor place a disagreeing gesture without erasing history.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a successor able to recover intention and change direction while keeping work legible. Reading: The artefact supplies state, seed, format, take-up, terminal path and door generation for a recoverable next move with history intact. Other levels: Below would be a described step without entry, falsified by runnable serve and place; above would need several directions reopening joint relation, falsified by single-operator instrument and no resolve gesture.

judgments.verdict: Prose, ledger, celestial strata, answer card and dialogs together make seam, ledger, threshold and ghost perceptible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks language, structure, interaction and image to express touchable material and its gestures. Reading: Receipt prose, facet pulses, distinct strata per hand, pressures and handoff work together to show the reading. Other levels: Below as fragmented form fails against integrated field-ledger-protocol; above as coherent accessible whole fails because field is browser-only, small-screen labels hide and layout is untested.

judgments.verdict: Paper memory, ledger, celestial field, five hands and dialogs together make the reading perceptible, though the field stays browser-only and untested for layout.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms that let touch, resistance and trail be felt rather than merely named. Reading: Language, ledger, interaction and celestial map work together with cues, aria-live, keyboard and reduced-motion to show the interpretation in use. Other levels: Below would be fragments, above would need a coherent accessible whole; browser-only field and untested pixels keep it from above.

judgments.verdict: Paper memory, celestial field, answer card, ledger and five hands use matching language and colour to make the reading perceptible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where language, structure, interaction and image together convey portal becoming material. Reading: The artefact aligns hand colours, paper memory, field strata and ledger copy into a usable whole. Other levels: Below would be fragments, falsified by integrated answer, field and ledger loop; above would need a fully accessible consequential whole, falsified by browser-only field and untested pixel layout.

presentation.title: From conjecture to continuation
presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: A single operator acts on an instrument.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Rehearsal, resistance and revision form a coherent loop.
Independent judgment: Medium, scope and choices have a coherent source-grounded rationale.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible.
